headline: European Gas Prices Hit Four-Year High on Winter Supply Concerns
summary: European wholesale gas prices rose to €97 per megawatt-hour, reaching levels last seen in 2022. Lower regional temperatures and geopolitical tensions involving the Middle East fueled supply disruption fears.
why: Natural gas is a primary fuel for electricity generation, industrial production, and home heating across Europe.
why_moved: Geopolitical conflict risks and cold weather forecasts directly tighten perceived winter fuel balances.
